changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders.

study.title: juteML24
study.description: Strengthen seed systems of African vegetables and scale variety adoption so that farmers and urban consumers benefit from increased production and consumption of African vegetables, which are nutritious but currently underutilized.

location_privacy.method: Each site displaced to a random point within a fixed radius, reproducible per site id. Sites published in release v1 keep their v1 coordinates.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised
location_privacy.gap_filling: Sites without a point take the mean of located sites with the same administrative names, pooled across all published trials (adm2+adm3, then adm3, then adm2, within 30 km of their mean), before displacement. coordinate_source names the level, coordinate_uncertainty_m adds the spread of the pool.
